summary: At its 2026-09-30 investor day Synopsys guided FY2027 revenue $11.1-11.2B and EPS $19.04-19.12 (above consensus), targeted ~15% revenue CAGR to 2030, announced a >$1B AWS IP deal, an OpenAI partnership and ~$1B buyback. Shares rose 4.8%, then 12.8% on 2026-10-01.
support_reason: Above-consensus guidance, long-term targets, a contracted $1B+ AWS deal and buyback.
